display_en:
Case: Aya, four years old
Coughs and appears to struggle for breath
Family asks: can it wait until tomorrow?
narration_fil: Umuubo at tila hirap huminga si Aya, apat na taong gulang. Nagtanong ang pamilya kung puwedeng bukas na magpatingin.
narration_en: Four-year-old Aya coughs and appears to struggle for breath. The family asks whether she can wait until tomorrow.

display_en:
Observe breathing difficulty; ask about danger signs
Arrange prompt clinical assessment
A trained assessor uses the current age-specific chart
Report observations; do not choose a diagnosis
narration_fil: Obserbahan ang hirap sa paghinga at itanong ang danger signs. Kapag hirap huminga, iugnay agad sa klinikal na pagsusuri. Ang sanay na assessor ang gagamit ng kasalukuyang chart ayon sa edad para sa bilis ng paghinga. Iulat ang nakita nang hindi pumipili ng diagnosis.
narration_en: Observe breathing difficulty and ask about general danger signs. Arrange prompt clinical assessment when breathing is difficult. A trained assessor uses the current age-specific chart for respiratory rate; report observations without choosing a diagnosis.

What is the first response?
Choose before reading the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Hirap huminga si Aya at gustong maghintay ng pamilya hanggang bukas. Ano ang uuna?
check.prompt_en: Aya struggles for breath and her family asks to wait until tomorrow. What comes first?

options.fil: Sabihing puwede na bukas basta magpahinga siya ngayong gabi.
options.en: Tell the family tomorrow is fine if she rests tonight.

options.fil: Bilangin ang hinga at mag-refer lang kung lampas sa lumang bilang.
options.en: Count her breaths and refer only above the old number.
Arrange prompt assessment of her breathing.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Huwag ipangakong puwedeng maghintay ang batang hirap huminga. Kailangang agad masuri si Aya. 2: Hindi tanging batayan ng referral ang isang lumang bilang. Ang sanay na assessor ang gagamit ng kasalukuyang chart ayon sa edad. 3: Tama. Kapag hirap huminga, agad iugnay sa klinikal na pagsusuri sa kumpirmadong daan.
check.feedback_en: 1: Do not promise that a child with breathing difficulty can wait. Aya needs prompt assessment. 2: One old breathing number is not a stand-alone referral rule. A trained assessor uses the current age-specific chart. 3: Right. When breathing is difficult, arrange prompt clinical assessment through the confirmed route.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read the explanation for each option.

display_fil:
Gustong maghintay ng pamilya ni Aya
Inilarawan ng BHW ang paghinga sa simpleng salita
Walang pangakong puwedeng maghintay
Agad ipasuri; iulat ang nakita
display_en:
Aya's family wants to wait
The BHW describes the breathing plainly
No promise that it can wait
Prompt assessment; report what was seen
narration_fil: Tila hirap huminga si Aya, at gustong maghintay ng pamilya hanggang bukas. Inilalarawan ng BHW ang paghinga sa simpleng salita at itinatanong ang danger signs. Sinasabi niyang hindi niya maipapangakong puwedeng maghintay, at agad niyang ipinasusuri si Aya. Iniuulat niya ang nakita. Ang sanay na assessor ang bahala sa chart at diagnosis.
narration_en: Aya appears to struggle for breath, and her family asks to wait until tomorrow. The BHW describes the breathing in plain words and asks about danger signs. She tells the family she cannot promise it can wait and arranges prompt assessment. She reports what she saw and leaves the rate chart and diagnosis to the trained assessor.

display_fil:
Huwag umasa sa iisang lumang bilang ng temperatura o paghinga
Huwag ipangakong puwedeng maghintay ang batang hirap huminga
display_en:
Do not use one old temperature or breathing number alone
Do not promise that a child who struggles to breathe can wait
narration_fil: Huwag gawing tanging batayan ng referral ang isang lumang bilang ng temperatura o paghinga. Huwag ipangakong maaaring maghintay ang batang hirap huminga.
narration_en: Do not use a single old temperature or respiratory-rate threshold as a stand-alone referral rule, or promise that a child with breathing difficulty can wait.

display_fil:
Ano ang dapat iulat?
Subukan bago tingnan ang paliwanag.
display_en:
What should the report include?
Try before viewing the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Tumawag ang BHW sa kumpirmadong contact tungkol kay Aya. Ano ang dapat iulat?
check.prompt_en: The BHW calls the confirmed contact about Aya. What should the report include?

options.fil: Ang itsura ng paghinga at ang sagot sa danger signs.
options.en: What the breathing looks like and the danger-sign answers.

options.fil: Na malamang pulmonya ang sakit ni Aya at kailangan agad ng gamot.
options.en: That Aya probably has pneumonia and needs medicine right away.

options.fil: Ang temperatura lang, dahil lagnat ang magpapasya kung puwedeng maghintay.
options.en: Only her temperature, since fever decides whether she can wait.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Tama. Iulat ang nakita at ang sagot sa danger signs; ang sanay na assessor ang magpapasya sa iba. 2: Iulat ang nakita nang hindi pumipili ng diagnosis. Ang sanay na assessor ang magpapasya. 3: Hindi tanging batayan ang isang temperatura, at naiiwan pa ang hirap sa paghinga.
check.feedback_en: 1: Right. Report observations and danger-sign answers; the trained assessor decides the rest. 2: Report observations without choosing a diagnosis. The trained assessor decides. 3: A single temperature is not a stand-alone rule, and it leaves out the breathing difficulty.

narration_fil: Balikan ang kuwento. Piliin ang angkop na susunod na hakbang.
narration_en: Return to the story. Choose an appropriate next step.
